qa_pair.question: Connect with document-metadata permission, inspect available tools, then verify a bounded document read. How many tools are exposed without granting business-record access?
Find the synthetic catalog record named First through search, then read its complete record. What expected_version should an update retain?
Find the earliest of all three synthetic catalog records using pages of two while preserving the search constraint. What is its name?
Confirm that the catalog contains records, then search for a name absent from the fixture. How many exact matches can honestly be offered without changing the query?
Inspect a catalog-only schema, then request FAQ records. What machine-readable error tells the client to obtain explicit permission rather than widen access?
Inspect the available read/proposal tools and the scoped business schema before preparing a batch. What is the maximum number of operations in one change set?
Read the schema and a bounded record search. Do both successful responses expose the same JSON through text and structuredContent for old and new clients?
Attempt to read an absent catalog ID, follow the returned recovery instruction by searching the same entity, and obtain an existing record. Which error code identified the first failure?
Discover the preview tool, read the schema and preview a synthetic create operation without submitting. Do the read-only annotation and unchanged proposal/business record counts agree?
Inspect the search input schema, try a page beyond its documented bound, then repair the request to page one with identical filters. What error code identifies the invalid first request?
